label: verify-bm-open-hardware-repro

claims.claim: Every Formlabs line is priced from official store pages on 2026-11-12: Form 4 Basic $2,625, Wash V2 $699, Cure V2 $999, two extra tanks $238, 1 L resins $149-$199; Formlabs core is $5,108.
claims.source_says: Form 4 Basic $2,625; Form Wash V2 $699; Form Cure V2 $999; Form 4 Resin Tank $119; Flexible 80A 1 L $199; Flexible 50A $199; Tough 1000 $149.

claims.claim: Open Material Mode for Form 4 is officially $875, lifetime, per printer, contradicting the earlier file's reseller price of $3,748.50.
claims.source_says: Open Material Mode for Form 4 (non-biocomp) $875. Optional, one-time purchase per printer for lifetime access.
claims.note: The $875 lifetime per-printer price is confirmed; I did not read the earlier file, so the contradiction is unchecked.

claims.claim: A bilayer is built as one PreForm project of two builds (one resin per build, one tank per resin); no Formlabs statement of two resins in one job.
claims.source_says: PreForm supports projects—you can set up builds across different printers and materials. Separate tank for each individual resin color or type, switching materials is as easy as sliding in a new tank.
claims.note: Both quoted passages exist, but neither says a bilayer should be built this way; the 'no statement' part is an absence the sources cannot confirm.

claims.claim: Instruments follow from the signal: 0.1 mg balance for strips (1 mg only for the 8% resin), optical length at about 10 um/pixel with a certified scale, about 2 um pixels for thickness.
claims.source_says: resolution.py output: Flexible 80A V2 strip 174.4 mg; 0.1 mg balance error 0.3% at 8% uptake, 1 mg 2.9%; 80 um and 4.0 um targets; 2400 dpi = 10.6 um; thickness pixel <= 2.0 um.
claims.note: I re-ran the script and the numbers reproduce, though the instrument choice itself rests on the agent's tolerance assumptions.

overall: Three of four key claims hold on re-check: the Formlabs prices and the $5,108 sum, the resolution.py figures, and the $875 lifetime Open Material Mode price. The bilayer claim is only partly supported. I did not read the earlier file the Open Material Mode claim says it contradicts.
